verdict.rationale: Proa ships built-in signals for islands, each emitting seed state with a shared runtime (proa-gh-3, proa-docs-16), and a typed WebContext that exposes route state during renders (proa-docs-18). That shows first-party state primitives with no third-party library, but the signals are scoped to individual islands and WebContext is request-scoped, so application-wide state is not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented global or shared state primitive across islands/components, store/context API docs for app-wide state, examples, independent corroboration.
